title: Austin OKs New Vehicle For-Hire Services
summary:
*   Austin officials approved permits for three individuals to operate "service cars."
*   These "service cars" were an early form of commercial vehicle transport, likely used for taxi, livery, or delivery services.
*   The City Council's decision to grant these new licenses was unanimous.
